architecture.title: Architecture creates balance
architecture.subtitle: Analytics needs architecture that bridges technology, governance, and business meaning.
points: Connect technology to business meaning, ensuring that platforms, data products and analytics remain grounded in shared definitions and business objectives.
Make governance an enabler, establishing the ownership, standards and decision boundaries needed to scale analytics without creating unnecessary friction.
Design for continuous evolution, modernizing progressively, preserving trusted foundations while creating room for new platforms, capabilities and use cases.
